decisions.decision: Before AI modifies source code, read relevant accepted .memory decisions from the target repository's verified Git checkout; do not rely on .memory being present in a published ZIP or VSIX.
Automatic repairs must be idle-only during local 12:00–12:59, use verified GitHub write credentials, run tests and open PRs without auto-merge.

All 18 SDLC agents and harness definitions must honor their own trusted role SKILL.md and .memory/role-boundaries.json. When another role must create/modify an exclusive deliverable, request a user-confirmed role switch; never auto-switch, assign new roles, bypass permissions or claim other roles' approvals. Cross-role explanatory questions and dependency reviews remain in the selected role.
